# Nexnetra

> Nexnetra is an AI cybersecurity assistant that analyzes URLs, emails, and social content for phishing and security threats.

- [Nexnetra](https://nex-nethra-frontend.vercel.app/): Home — AI cybersecurity assistant
- [Analyzer](https://nex-nethra-frontend.vercel.app/analyzer): Analyze URLs and content for security threats
- [Sign In](https://nex-nethra-frontend.vercel.app/sign-in): Account sign in
